Trace, implement and test: 05.08.Draw Line

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> drawLine(int length, int w, int x1, int x2, int y) {
        vector<int> ans(length);
        int i = (y * w + x1) / 32;
        int j = (y * w + x2) / 32;
        for (int k = i; k <= j; ++k) {
            ans[k] = -1;
        }
        ans[i] = ans[i] & unsigned(-1) >> (x1 % 32);
        ans[j] = ans[j] & unsigned(-1) << (31 - x2 % 32);
        return ans;
    }
};
